problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign packages to identical delivery trucks. The packages are as follows:

* Package Alpha: weight 33kg
* Package Bravo: weight 36kg
* Package Charlie: weight 54kg
* Package Delta: weight 36kg
* Package Echo: weight 56kg
* Package Foxtrot: weight 38kg
* Package Golf: weight 60kg
* Package Hotel: weight 66kg
* Package India: weight 66kg
* Package Juliet: weight 49kg
* Package Kilo: weight 66kg
* Package Lima: weight 54kg
* Package Mike: weight 30kg
* Package November: weight 64kg
* Package Oscar: weight 32kg
* Package Papa: weight 66kg
* Package Quebec: weight 43kg
* Package Romeo: weight 40kg
* Package Sierra: weight 68kg
* Package Tango: weight 41kg
* Package Uniform: weight 59kg
* Package Victor: weight 41kg
* Package Whiskey: weight 58kg
* Package X-ray: weight 42kg
* Package Yankee: weight 30kg
* Package Zulu: weight 62kg
* Package Asterisk: weight 32kg
* Package Dash: weight 62kg
* Package Plus: weight 60kg
* Package Equals: weight 61kg
* Package Ampersand: weight 54kg
* Package Percent: weight 47kg
* Package Dollar: weight 59kg
* Package Pound: weight 51kg
* Package At: weight 69kg
* Package Hash: weight 69kg

Each truck can carry a maximum load of 100 kg. Assign all packages using the minimum number of trucks. Every package must be placed on exactly one truck, and the total weight loaded onto any truck cannot exceed its capacity.
